# ADR-014: Store rotational agility with source binary32 semantics

Status: chosen_for_source_field_storage

Concerns: Q-behavior, Q-state, Q-reproduce

## Decision

Generate one f32 metadata/snapshot field. Preserve raw writes, including negative/zero/nonfinite values, because OnModified follows the field prewrite. Reuse the existing nonpositive-to-one AST for the distinct dynamic-constructor rule. Finite JSON numbers remain readable; a versioned u32 tag preserves nonfinite payloads.

## Rationale

MAP_ATTRIBUTE uses READWRITE/NOTIFY/PERSIST on mRotAgility. The notification setter returns or writes that same float; the dynamic constructor has a separate <=0 -> 1 rule. Independent original C++ scalar observations distinguish those contracts.

## Alternatives

Clamp the raw property as though it were only SetBallAngularAgility; retain f64 shadow state; serialize NaNs as null.

## Consequences

Fifteen raw patterns survive ordinary snapshots; retained old generations mutate independently of replacement balls. Dynamic evolution and full dynamic snapshot restore are still rejected; this is no claim of their implementation or Blue ABI equivalence.
